Defined in: core/store/state.ts:77

Viewport-space rectangle the expand-modal genie transition warps from/to — the clicked figure's getBoundingClientRect() snapshot. Kept on the descriptor (not the media item) because it's transition state, not media data; null on deep-link auto-opens (the genie resolves the figure at mount time instead).
